card.title: Self-Service Checkouts
card.passage: Many supermarkets have introduced self-service checkouts. Customers scan the products they buy and pay by themselves. Supermarkets can reduce the number of workers needed at checkouts, and in this way they can save money. However, some older customers find these machines difficult to use, so staff members are still needed to help them.

bubbles.t: Let's make a cake for Dad's birthday!

card.start: One day, Yuki was talking with her mother in the living room.

steps.t: Hello. My name is Ms. Brown. May I have your name, please?
Thank you. This is the Grade Pre-2 Plus test. OK? How are you today?
Let's start the test. Here is your card.
First, please read the passage silently for 20 seconds.
All right. Now, please read it aloud.
Now, I'll ask you four questions.
Number 1. According to the passage, how can supermarkets save money?
Number 2. Now, please look at the pictures and describe the situation. You have 20 seconds to prepare. Your story should begin with the sentence on the card.
Now, please turn over the card and put it down.
Number 3. Do you think it is a good idea for stores to use more machines instead of workers?
Number 4. Some people say that students should learn about money at school. Do you agree with this opinion?
This is the end of the test. Could I have the card back, please?
Thank you. You may go now.

points: and in this way の前で区切る
長い文はまとまりごとに

q1.q: According to the passage, how can supermarkets save money?
q1.ja: スーパーはどうやってお金を節約できますか。
model: By reducing the number of workers needed at checkouts.
points: in this way が指す内容

q2.ja: 3コマのイラストの話を、カードの最初の文から説明してください。
model: One day, Yuki was talking with her mother in the living room. Her mother said to her, "Let's make a cake for Dad's birthday!" At the supermarket, Yuki was putting strawberries into the shopping cart, and her mother was looking at a shopping list. When they got home, they realized that they had forgotten to buy eggs.
points: 過去形・過去進行形で
コマの間の言葉(At the supermarket / At home)を使う
吹き出しのセリフは said to ～, "…"

q3.q: Do you think it is a good idea for stores to use more machines instead of workers?
q3.ja: 店が店員の代わりに機械をもっと使うのは良い考えだと思いますか。

model.yes: Yes. → Machines can work for many hours without a break. Stores can keep their prices low.
model.no: No. → Some people cannot use machines well. They need workers to help them.

points: 具体的な人や場面を入れる

q4.q: Some people say that students should learn about money at school. Do you agree with this opinion?
q4.ja: 学校でお金について学ぶべきだという意見に賛成ですか。

model.yes: Yes. → Young people will need to manage their own money in the future. It is important to learn how to save money early.
model.no: No. → Students can learn about money from their families. Schools should spend more time on other subjects.

points: I think ～ / For example, ～ を使ってもOK
